about: Routing eval: give a fresh agent ONLY SKILL.md and each prompt; it must name the section and the key file(s). Pass = every expected file named (extra files allowed). Run by hand or with a subagent; record results in BUILD-STATUS.md.

cases.prompt: Give me 10 headlines for my new video about Meta ads.
Package this video: thumbnails, titles, description and LinkedIn post.
Write the YouTube description with chapters, here's the transcript.
What makes a good thumbnail?
Break down the framework we use for choosing headlines.
How do we decide what goes in the description, based on the research?
Which experts did we research and what did we find?
This thumbnail is flat, make it darker and make it pop.
I don't have a photo of myself, make a thumbnail with objects instead.
Give me the LinkedIn and YouTube versions of the thumbnail we picked.
Write a LinkedIn post to promote the video.
Make me a thumbnail in Riley Brown's style.
Is this thumbnail any good? Why isn't it getting clicks?
What's working for @somecreator right now?
Keep an eye on these three channels and tell me weekly what broke out.
Save this call to action and add it to our CTA list.
It's been two days and the CTR is below average, should I change the title?
Save this batch to the Thumbnails page in the Whiteboard Wednesdays app.
fetch_videos keeps getting blocked by YouTube, what do I do?
Which layout should I use for a full course video?
Give me five different thumbnail variations, a couple black and the rest lighter, with emojis on some.
These all look the same. Can we get more variety in the fonts and backgrounds?
